title: [SBW] Biome Soldiers
description: Adds three biome-specific soldier patrols that spawn naturally with SBW firearms and Marbled's Arsenal armor — Desert, SWAT, and Winter variants.
body:
**\[SBW\] Biome Soldiers**

⚠️ **REQUIRED MODS** — install all of these or the game will crash:

Superb Warfare • Marbled's Arsenal • Marbled's Core • GeckoLib

For Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

Adds armed soldier NPCs that spawn around the world by biome, plus personal bodyguards you can command. Every unit uses real Superb Warfare guns and Marbled's Arsenal armor.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_cc0016f8-71ca-4457-8c31-ea5e189b54ab.png)

🪖 **Biome Soldiers**

Hostile NPCs that spawn naturally and shoot players & mobs on sight:

Desert Soldier — spawns in deserts & badlands

Winter Soldier — spawns in snowy & taiga biomes

SWAT Soldier — spawns across other overworld biomes

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_4c95c3de-f503-4b47-9076-319c4e542f95.png)

🛡️ **Bodyguards (Lvl 1–3)**

Personal guards that belong to you (spawn them with eggs). Higher level = stronger weapons & armor.

Shift + Right-Click → toggle Follow / Guard mode

Right-Click → open their gear menu (weapon / ammo / armor)

Attack one while it follows you and the whole squad fires back

🚗 Vehicle escort — when you board a Superb Warfare vehicle, your following bodyguards climb in with you if there's a free seat. If the vehicle is full, they escort on foot alongside it (kept clear of its path so it won't run them over), and hop out automatically when you do.

🚩 **Protected Zones**

Use the Zone Marker to claim land. Inside your zone, explosions, lava, fire and environmental damage are blocked. Manage it with /zone (trust players, delete, give blocks, and more).

⚙️ Note: Protected Zones are OFF by default. To enable them, change the mod's config in-game with the command /config showfile militarybase COMMON and set zonesEnabled to true.
